title: Saying and Seeing
label: ch:ar-saying-and-seeing
canDo: I can say the Arabic for 'he said' and 'he saw', read the letters qāf and alif maqṣūra, and name the doer, done-to, place and instrument words each root builds.

payoff.summary: Say raʾā, read its dotless alif maqṣūra, follow the root out into raʾy 'opinion' and mirʾāh 'mirror', and restate the pattern family qāla laid out.
